# Psychiatry Clinics

This folder catalogs specific child, adolescent, and adult psychiatric outpatient clinics and departments across Denmark that report data to the national ADHD quality database. The pages detail each facility's performance against national diagnostic and treatment standards—such as somatic examinations, environmental observations, and psychotherapy metrics—highlighting both exceptional outliers that meet stringent targets and units struggling with systemic resource constraints. Every page preserves exact statistical claims, quality indicator fulfillments, and operational volumes traced back to the original annual database reports.

## Pages

- [[aabenna-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|"Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium"]] — A Region Syddanmark facility recognized as a rare positive outlier that successfully meets national standards for foundational ADHD diagnostic requirements and environmental observations.
- [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-for-skoleboern|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Skolebørn]] — An Aarhus Universitetshospital department for school children that achieved top national fulfillment rates for somatic examinations and environmental observations.
- [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-for-unge|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge]] — A Midtjylland youth psychiatry clinic notable for its data validation practices and its reflection of nationwide structural struggles in cross-sectoral coordinating network meetings.
- [[hillerod-psykiatrisk-ambulatorium-boern-og-unge|"Hillerød: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge"]] — A Zealand-based outpatient unit that recorded the highest fulfillment rate among larger facilities for somatic assessments, despite mixed results in age-specific diagnostic metrics.
- [[odense-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|"Odense: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium"]] — A Region Syddanmark clinic distinguished as the only department in the country to fully meet the standard for structured diagnostic interviews for older children, while also leading in post-diagnostic coordination.
- [[pck-psykoterapeutisk-klinik|"PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik"]] — A Region Hovedstaden facility tracked for adult ADHD metrics, standing out with the highest measured fulfillment rate for adult psychotherapy during a shortened initial reporting period.
